Our story

Built for clarity over complexity

Tailcast was born from experience with analytics tools that bury insights under layers of complexity. We set out to build something different - a platform that's powerful enough for engineers yet intuitive enough for the entire team.

Real-time event pipeline

Ingest millions of events per second with sub-100ms latency. See what's happening right now, not what happened yesterday.

Insights on autopilot

Dashboards that build themselves, reports that deliver on schedule, and funnels that highlight where users drop off - without writing a single query.

Security

Enterprise-grade security, built in

Your data is encrypted at rest and in transit. We're SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant. Role-based access, SSO, and audit logs come standard - not as enterprise add-ons.

SOC 2 Type II GDPR SSO / SAML Encryption Audit Logs
